# Daniel Ye

> Daniel Ye is a Ph.D. candidate in Industrial Engineering at Iowa State University. His research focuses on computational geometry for additive manufacturing, including 3D deformation modeling, predictive compensation, geometric representation, model processing, and fabrication accuracy.
